scope: Seven legal IU forms only; no faults, reset epochs, branches or long-lived results within a trace.
sampling: One record per rising edge before nonblocking state updates; all events in one record are simultaneous.

manual_relations.manual: Dispatch latches operands at stage end; reservation stations may wait for unavailable operands.
manual_relations.implementation_binding: D is RS capture; E is later IU capture. These are two separate RTL edges. Manual end-of-dispatch is not certified as D or E under every stall.

manual_relations.manual: Latency is execution until results are ready for a subsequent instruction; finish is final execute cycle updating CQ.
manual_relations.implementation_binding: The occupied computation interval [E,E+1) ends in finish acceptance at E+1. This agrees with one execute-cycle duration; D-to-finish is at least two edges, not the table latency.

manual_relations.manual: Completion removes CQ entry in order; some cases can finish and complete in one cycle.
manual_relations.implementation_binding: Implementation commit requires a previously registered finish. The missing same-cycle path is a deliberate conservative choice, not full timing conformance.

manual_relations.manual: Writeback updates architectural registers at completion or through a nonflushable writeback buffer.
manual_relations.implementation_binding: Current legal retire edge combines completion, architectural GPR write and CQ/rename release. There is no separate writeback buffer.

manual_relations.manual: Five completion buffers and five GPR rename buffers are required dispatch resources; rename lifespan includes deallocate in resource discussion.
manual_relations.implementation_binding: Release occurs at retire edge; next cycle exposes freed capacity. Full allocation cannot reclaim at the same edge. Manual exact release availability remains unbound.

manual_relations.manual: Figures show integer D1 E2 W3 A4, but younger integer W precedes older FP W in multiple rows.
manual_relations.implementation_binding: Retain literal cells and TIM-U17; do not equate W to an architectural commit or A to a forced RTL release edge.

manual_relations.manual: IU has one execute phase; PID7v SRU can also run selected adds without serialization.
manual_relations.implementation_binding: All seven current forms use IU only and width one. Table throughput, second dispatch/completion, and SRU routing are outside this probe.

manual_relations.manual: A waiting reservation-station instruction can begin execution in the same clock cycle that the register file receives its needed data; ordinary IU forms are not in the completion-serialization classes.
manual_relations.implementation_binding: Accepted producer finish and dependent IU issue may share an edge using ownership-qualified bypass. This demonstrates the current forwarding relation, not an exact source diagram binding.

events.dispatch: dut.dispatch with CQ/rename/RS allocation; identifier is packed completion index and generation
events.finish: dut.completion.finish_accept; ownership-valid completion only, not generic result transport
events.release: CQ and GPR rename valid bits clear on legal commit; pre-edge occupancy is checked next edge

checker_relations: exact E+1 ownership-valid finish, because CQ result_ready is always asserted outside reset
independent decode/RAW producer order and operand/result values
oldest retirement and stable stalled packet
CQ and rename occupancy at every edge; no full same-edge reclamation
drain every dispatched instruction and exercise all seven forms

open_decisions.text: Bind source stage-colored intervals and finish/completion edge conventions; resolve younger graphical W versus ordered completion prose before replay.
Determine exact CQ/rename deallocation availability and whether separate deallocation cycle/bypass is required. Current simultaneous release remains a disclosed choice.
Review dispatch-to-execute boundary, same-cycle finish/completion and width/SRU admission before claiming core matches 603e throughput.
